posts.name: WarrenAC
posts.cooked:
No unlock, but I just tried the obvious test of "defeat Cosmic Omnitron in Omnitron IV with Bunker (under 10HP)"

Fought Cosmic Omnitron in Omnitron IV with Legacy, Team Leader Tachyon, Tempest, Bunker and the Sentinels. 

Had Bunker under 10 HP (he hit himself with the Omni-Cannon),  and the Sentinels punched Cosmic out.  So it's not quite that straightforward.

Cosmic Omnitron is scary,  but ended up totally under control despite starting the game with two interpolation beams, a railgun and two EPEs.  Legacy started with Heroic Interception, and boy did he intercept those EPEs.  After that there was Take-Down and Writhe managed to stack non-Drones on Omnitron's deck so in the end we just punched him down.  

It would make sense that Omnitron and/or Omnitron IV is involved since there is Omnitron tech in the suit? Or was it Omnitron that uses tech from the suit?
